properties.name: 2D light playground
properties.description: A playground for the 2D lights: walls casting shadows from torches, moving lights and obstacles, and hundreds of obstacles at once.

events.comment: Press 1, 2 or 3 to go to the other scenes.
Every brick of the walls is a light obstacle. The flashlight has a texture: it turns, and its light turns with it.
Press 1, 2 or 3 to go to the other scenes.
The crates and the doors turn, the pillars slide: the shadows follow them. Three coloured lights go around, and the lantern (a light with a texture) turns.
Press 1, 2 or 3 to go to the other scenes.
Hundreds of crates are light obstacles. The pink light follows the mouse, the spot lights (lights with a texture) turn slowly.

tests.description: The lights of each scene are where they should be: the torches in the dungeon, the coloured lights going around, the pink light following the mouse.
tests.name: The lights move as expected
source: harness.assert(Math.abs(red.x - 640) > 100, 'The red light moved away from the center.');
harness.assert(Math.round(cursorLight.x) === 500 && Math.round(cursorLight.y) === 300, 'The pink light follows the mouse.');

tests.description: Draw each scene, at the start and after the lights and obstacles moved, to compare the shadows with the expected images.
tests.name: Rendering: the lights and shadows of each scene
